description: This file defines a React component CostsGroupedBarChart that renders a responsive grouped bar chart for displaying cost data per agent, grouped by environment or cost category. It includes imports from external libraries like React and recharts, utility functions, and theme modules. The component handles data shaping, themes, loading and error states, and rendering of the chart with accessibility features.

methods.name: CostsGroupedBarChart
methods.description: React component that renders a grouped bar chart for agent costs, supporting grouping by environment or cost category, with handling for loading/error states and optional group selector.
